title: Depotentiation of emotional reactivity using TMR during REM sleep
description: This dataset contains fMRI, polysomnography (EEG/EMG/EOG), ECG and pulse oximetry, and behavioural data from a study of Targeted Memory Reactivation (TMR) during REM sleep and its effect on emotional reactivity. Participants rated the arousal of 48 affective images paired with matching sounds, and half of the sounds were cued during overnight REM sleep. Arousal ratings and heart rate deceleration were assessed at baseline, in an MRI scanner 48 hours later, and in an online follow-up two weeks after baseline.
methods_description: Structural and functional MRI were acquired on a Siemens Magnetom Prisma 3T scanner with a 32-channel head coil. Heart rate was recorded with a BrainVision BrainAmp ExG during the behavioural sessions and by pulse oximetry during fMRI. Polysomnography used six EEG channels, two EMG channels and two EOG channels, referenced to the averaged mastoids. fMRI data were preprocessed with fMRIPrep 20.2.7, and T1-weighted images were defaced with pydeface 2.0.2.
